title: Toolkit lock
description: toolkit.lock (YAML) in an L2 project, or in L1 dotfiles: the exact promptbook commit (L3), the portable skill libraries it runs beside (L3), and the implementation packs (L4) this project runs, pinned by commit and tree hash. Dependencies point one way: everything pins one promptbook.

generated_by.description: Tool and version that wrote the lock, e.g. promptbook/lock@1.0.0.

contains.description: Exactly one pinned promptbook: the L3 entry that is not a skill library (kind promptbook, or no kind).

kind.description: What the entry is. L3: promptbook (exactly one; an L3 entry with no kind is promptbook) or skill-library (any number of portable skill sets, e.g. Skilldex). L4: engine-binding, stack-pack, runtime, domain-pack.

source.description: A git URL or a local path.

path.description: Subdirectory inside the source, for a pack that lives in a larger repository.

ref.description: The tag or branch the commit was resolved from.

tree.description: Git tree id of the pinned content (of path, when set). Detects a rewritten tag or a force-pushed mirror.

version.description: Semver; build metadata pins an untagged source to its commit (0.0.0+fc572b6).

autoUpdate.description: How far an updater may move this pin without a human: off, or within patch / minor / major. A mirrored vendor pack is off.

mirrored.description: The source is a mirror of an upstream; the upstream it tracks.

sets.description: A skill library's install sets this consumer copies into its skills folders, by the names in the library's SETS.yaml (Skilldex's: planning, delivery, personal, ...).

allOf.description: Only a skill library has install sets.
